hotels.title: Stylish Bangkok Surawong Stay in the Heart of the City
hotels.description: In Bangkok’s storied Surawong district, this contemporary retreat places you close to Silom Road, Sri Maha Mariamman Temple and the riverfront precinct of Asiatique. Rooms and suites balance sleek design with warm timber detailing, while select categories frame city views across one of the capital’s oldest neighbourhoods. Thai and international dishes are served at the hotel’s restaurant, followed by crafted drinks and skyline vistas at the rooftop bar. Beyond the hotel, Yaowarat Road is known for late-night seafood, while Charoenkrung draws visitors with independent boutiques, galleries and cafés
